g.text: Early accuracy gains do not guarantee a joint qualification benefit

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51616e

g.text: Held-out TEST sources shown separately · Consistent 16-code intent classification throughout

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263642

g.text: At 8 updates, every history qualifies on all 13 intents: 7/7 in TEST-a and 6/6 in TEST-b.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42515e

g.text: Joint gate per intent: original-code accuracy ≥80%, gain ≥30 percentage points, and new-skill guard loss ≤10 points from its own baseline.

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42515e

g.text: Protocol: same repair inputs/order; fresh AdamW from each history’s post-stream checkpoint per budget; 4 original + 4 new examples per update.

text.style: font-size: 9.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42515e

g.text: Two source-model clusters; the 13 intents are not independent replicates. Descriptive comparisons; no significance tests or confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #697783

g.text: Independent raw audit complete · 86,208 records (including repeated panels) · analysis 0f3477af996a… · audit d4c70e2dc036…
